name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
description: The forest containing the waterfall and a grove Isilu has taken, where dawnglove grows.

timeline.summary: The group reaches the Gilt-Leaf Wood, where Kirol lags behind and is seized by a silent hunter.
timeline.quote: a silent hunter rose out of the bushes behind Kirol and grabbed them, pulling them out of sight before they could make a sound.

pages_say.description: A great wood with boughs woven like baskets where Lluwen captures Kirol.
The forest containing Lys Alana and the waterfall route to Glen Elendra.
